name: Lista imion występujących w rejestrze PESEL (Ministerstwo Cyfryzacji)
note: Every first name in the Polish population register, with how many people bear it.
PIOTR is borne by 682,516 men and ANNA by 1,063,756 women, and that weighting is the
point: a list of names produces uniform draws, and a register produces the collision
CC0, declared by dane.gov.pl's API with every licence condition field left empty --
checked directly rather than read off the portal page. So there is nothing to
reconcile with Apache-2.0 and no attribution obligation; NOTICE names it regardless,
for the same reason it names Wikidata.
Names with fewer than two bearers are already excluded upstream, which is the register
protecting individuals rather than a sampling decision. The adapter's own threshold
Two files because the register publishes men and women separately. The PŁEĆ column
repeats the distinction inside each, so the split is redundant, but taking the files
as published means the sex never has to be inferred.
